verdict.rationale: GitBook documents a built-in AI Assistant for readers ('I'm here to help you with the docs') and a GitBook Agent for reviewing change requests, showing task delegation to an in-product AI. However, evidence is first-party docs only, thin on scope/limits of what tasks can be delegated, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of the assistant actually completing delegated tasks. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of assistant task delegation, detail on the range of tasks the assistant/agent can autonomously perform, and confirmation beyond vendor docs.
